Hi guys I'm looking for recommendations. I want to be part of a community that has interest in experimenting how to unlock the best versions of themselves, inside their everyday life routine. Nothing like Bryan Johnson lab-test level. I mean more mundane.
For example, I am someone who LOVES to sleep. Food and sleep are the foundation for my mind to perform at its best. Easily, I could sleep 16 hours a day. But, I've realized that sleeping 7-8 hours, but only from (9-10 pm until 5am) is my sweet spot.

I woke up naturally, but always had to force myself to go back to sleep, and woke up around 7-8-9 very tired.

I'm waking up 5am and honestly, I LOVE IT!

With this extra time I'm taking care of projects I didn't have time before. I thought about tracking my own habits, and now I'm thinking about tracking my own sleep.

I have a lot of information, that I wanna share with other people similar to me. As in, that look for experimenting, logic, and explanation. Test new theories, and want to bring excellence into their life.

I appreciate your comments!
